author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In our final video from this year's Wonderfest modelmaking show, we check out two executions of beautiful scale miniatures: a perfectly painted 1/25 Batwing from the 1989 Batman film, and an original vintage sci-fi spaceship concept with fully-detailed interior. Two beautiful models that impressed us at the show from builders at the top of their craft!

Check out more of Dwayne Ayer's model builds here: https://www.instagram.com/dwayneayerscalemodels/
Watch more videos from WonderFest here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJtitKU0CAeisqS5CxeSZ5MRXtlTULAqo
Learn more about WonderFest at https://www.wonderfest.com/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
